name: Corn Meal Griddle-Cakes (With Yeast)
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Stir into one quart of boiling milk three cups of corn meal
After it cools add one cup of white flour, a teaspoonful of salt and three tablespoonfuls of home-made yeast
In the morning add one tablespoonful of melted butter or lard, two beaten eggs and a teaspoonful of soda dissolved in a little water
Let batter stand a few minutes, after adding the butter and soda, that it should have time to rise a little
Melt together a tablespoonful of butter and lard, and grease the griddle with this
Put the cakes on by spoonfuls, or pour them carefully from a pitcher, trying to get them as near the same size as possible
As soon as they begin to bubble all over turn them, and cook on the other side till they stop puffing

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Stir into one quart of boiling milk three cups of corn meal
2. After it cools add one cup of white flour, a teaspoonful of salt and three tablespoonfuls of home-made yeast
3. Mix this over night
4. In the morning add one tablespoonful of melted butter or lard, two beaten eggs and a teaspoonful of soda dissolved in a little water
5. Let batter stand a few minutes, after adding the butter and soda, that it should have time to rise a little
6. Melt together a tablespoonful of butter and lard, and grease the griddle with this
7. Put the cakes on by spoonfuls, or pour them carefully from a pitcher, trying to get them as near the same size as possible
8. As soon as they begin to bubble all over turn them, and cook on the other side till they stop puffing
